Taiwan-based semiconductor manufacturing services company ASE Technology (ASX)
net revenue of NT$88.62B in October, up 47.1% Y/Y and 0.6% from September.
Revenues in U.S. dollars rose 40.4% Y/Y and 0.1% sequentially to $2.78B in October.
Net revenues for its ATM assembly, testing, and material business rose 57.7% Y/Y and 7.9% sequentially to NT$56.84B. In dollar terms, revenues increased 50.5% Y/Y and 7.4% sequentially to $1.78B.
